rejected.why: The query "Did Philip Glass work as a teacher?" targets a concrete factual entity (Philip Glass) and predicate (teacher), which is exactly the kind of factual retrieval query the taxonomy requires; it is not a meta-evaluative question about summaries or the claim's overall truth, so SP_06 does not apply (and its own do-not-use clause excludes factual queries like this).

The evidence shows a query repeating the prior hop's unresolved factual question rather than a meta/evaluative question about a claim or summary, so SP_06 is the wrong code; the underlying mistake is retained under SP_05 as a separate point rather than rejected outright.
